Given: K ÷ L − M + N × O

K ÷ L → K is the daughter of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50f4e0d96b9c11ffd69cd7e31a80e29c72cce018dbcb06eddf63cf1a194d894c.png] 

L − M → L is the husband of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b52e2f09dcf77a1d8fe19132f70420472cdf1b1481c7424fd793e5930b41e9e.png] 

M + N → M is the mother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd4a49b6d09a458fe5e614ca2c53e5d1b16d06dd6caebd2b27a07025f2d52581.png] 

N × O → N is the father of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d6c0b1b5678a9033886e766138071aaefbb04baff3297d7bf034063e31e1c28.png] 

Thus, K is O's father’s sister or paternal aunt.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
